title: OpenCode registry-install record (publishing plan step 5, and the bootstrap check)
description: What a registry-install probe measured about the bytes npm SERVES for one opencode-multi-llm version, installed by OpenCode from the single registry into a fresh environment. One shape, two uses: the canonical step-5 record (`<UTC>-opencode-release-network-check.json`, committed, sanitized, environment `container` or `vm`) and the bootstrap job's record (`<UTC>-opencode-bootstrap-check.json`, a workflow artifact, environment `ci-runner`). This schema is the STRUCTURAL half: closed key sets, so a probe that learns to log one more field cannot quietly turn a committed record into a transcript. The SEMANTIC half (which criteria a profile and release kind require, the tag binding, the first-release exception decided from the tag's commit, the offline network proof) lives in registry_record.py, the one validator, which also applies this file without the `jsonschema` package.

recorded_at.description: UTC ISO-8601; the <UTC> of the file name.

environment.description: `container` or `vm` for the release profile (the only environments that can cut the network for warm_offline_operation); `ci-runner` for the bootstrap profile only, whose workflow path was retired after opencode-v0.1.1.

workflow_run_id.description: The GitHub Actions run that would have produced a bootstrap record (that workflow path was retired after opencode-v0.1.1); null for a step-5 record.

rehearsal.description: A rehearsal (a localhost registry stub, a candidate commit standing in for the tag) measured the procedure, not a release, and can never be release evidence.

spec.description: The exact pin OpenCode was given, `<name>@<version>`.

registry.description: The registry every npm read and OpenCode's installer were pointed at: the single registry.

installed_registry.description: The registry the installed package actually came from, as measured.

release_kind.description: Must agree with the tag's commit: `first` while that commit's capabilities file has no hosts.opencode.package.public_version, `later` otherwise.

previous_pin.description: null on a first release; `<name>@<public_version>` at the tag's commit on a later one.

variables_set.description: Every environment variable the probe set, as step 5 requires.

evidence.description: The criterion's supporting output, preserved: a non-empty object (registry_record.py refuses an empty one).

network_proof.description: warm_offline_operation only: taken in that container just before and just after the offline operation.

network_mode.description: `docker inspect` .HostConfig.NetworkMode; a VM with its interface detached records `none` too.
